title: Scenarij 3: kompromitacija Kubernetes klastera
summary: Log4Shell u javnoj prodavnici, shell u podu, ukradeni ServiceAccount token sa preširokim ClusterRoleBindingom, čitanje tajni, privilegovani pod sa hostPath / i rudar kriptovaluta. Istraga kroz Falco alarme, Trivy izvještaj i Kubernetes audit log, pa RBAC po principu najmanjih privilegija, NetworkPolicy, hardening Deploymenta, rotacija i izvještaj.
summary_en: Log4Shell in a public web shop, a shell in a Pod, a stolen ServiceAccount token with an overly broad ClusterRoleBinding, reading Secrets, a privileged Pod with hostPath / and a cryptominer. Investigation through Falco alerts, a Trivy report and the Kubernetes audit log, followed by least-privilege RBAC, NetworkPolicy, Deployment hardening, rotation and the report.
